payload.core_mechanism_summary: Check if any '8' appears within the first n-11+1 characters, because we can delete preceding characters to make it the first digit.
payload.rationale: The algorithm uses a greedy condition: it suffices to find an '8' early enough, as deleting before it is always optimal. The subtype greedy_exchange_argument captures the proof that earlier 8 is always at least as good.
